description: One original English single-image post per day. Local weekdays use Asia/Kolkata time.

weekdays.direction: One precise, doable tactic for better organization, focus or planning. Show a concrete micro-action; never promise results.
Explain one accessible online-safety practice accurately, without fearmongering or recommending purchases.
Teach one accessible, timeless science concept using only the supplied fact. No extra scientific claims.
Suggest one practical home, learning or organization routine. No medical, nutrition, mental-health or financial advice.
Share a simple low-waste habit or household reuse idea, with no made-up impact figures or promises.
Offer a low-cost creative exercise or craft idea requiring no dangerous materials, tools, fire or chemicals.
Explain one accessible idea about living heritage, arts or cultural practices without attributing it to specific people or inventing historical claims.

Digital Safety.fact: A password manager can help create and store strong, unique passwords for different accounts.
Digital Safety.label: CISA — Password Managers

Digital Safety.fact: Multi-factor authentication adds a second check beyond a password when signing in.
Digital Safety.label: CISA — Secure Our World

Digital Safety.fact: Phishing messages may try to trick people into opening malicious attachments or sharing personal information.
Digital Safety.label: CISA — Secure Our World

Digital Safety.fact: Keeping software updated is one of CISA's recommended everyday steps for safer online activity.
Digital Safety.label: CISA — Secure Our World

Science & Nature.fact: The Sun is the star at the center of our solar system, and the planets orbit it.
Science & Nature.label: NASA — Solar System Facts

Science & Nature.fact: Condensation changes water vapor in air into liquid water and plays a role in cloud formation.
Science & Nature.label: USGS — Condensation

Science & Nature.fact: Evaporation changes liquid water into water vapor and is a part of the water cycle.
Science & Nature.label: USGS — Evaporation

Science & Nature.fact: Precipitation is water released from clouds as rain, snow, sleet or hail.
Science & Nature.label: USGS — Precipitation

Culture & Learning.fact: Intangible cultural heritage includes living oral traditions and expressions passed through communities.
Culture & Learning.label: UNESCO — Intangible Cultural Heritage

Culture & Learning.fact: Traditional craftsmanship is one form of intangible cultural heritage recognized by UNESCO.
Culture & Learning.label: UNESCO — Intangible Cultural Heritage

Culture & Learning.fact: Performing arts, social practices and festive events can be part of living cultural heritage.
Culture & Learning.label: UNESCO — Intangible Cultural Heritage

Culture & Learning.fact: Living heritage can evolve as communities carry knowledge, skills and traditions across generations.
Culture & Learning.label: UNESCO — Intangible Cultural Heritage
